info.title: Xarta HTTP and Workflow Capabilities API
info.summary: Contracts for all implemented Xarta v1 HTTP services and intake workflow nodes.
info.description: The union of independently deployable services. A deployment may expose only a subset; discover enabled workflow kinds at /api/v1/intake/capabilities. HTTP acceptance does not imply workflow completion. Canonical API paths are version-pinned; x-path-alias records the floating /api alias. Security requirements describe service-level enforcement only; ingress authorization is deployment-specific. NATS and MCP are separate protocols, not REST operations. See contracts/openapi/README.md for versioning and maintenance.

post.description: Verify Svix signature over the unchanged raw body, event id and timestamp against the configured destination secret. Provider-specific data fields are retained. Authentication, event age, ownership, and duplicate delivery are checked by the adapter.
X-Signature authenticates the provider canonical JSON payload. The owned document is re-read from the provider before reducing tracking state.

X-Signature is sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256> over unchanged request bytes. Authenticated owned outbound hints are durably queued before acknowledgment. An authenticated unowned hint returns accepted=true, queued=false.

post.description: Enabled only when configured. Maximum JSON body 64 KiB. Client certificate fingerprint must be allowlisted. Event aliases are accepted with precedence event_type, eventType, event; sender_name before senderName; receiverExternalReferenceId before external_receiver_id, receiver_id, receiverId. Event value must be RECEIVER_LINK_UNLINK.

Error400.description: Invalid request. Raised framework errors may use JSON, HTML or plain text according to Sanic negotiation.

Error401.description: Authentication failed. Raised framework errors may use JSON, HTML or plain text according to Sanic negotiation.

Error403.description: Station or site access denied. Raised framework errors may use JSON, HTML or plain text according to Sanic negotiation.

Error404.description: Resource not found or capability disabled. Raised framework errors may use JSON, HTML or plain text according to Sanic negotiation.

Error409.description: Identity, version, or retention conflict. Raised framework errors may use JSON, HTML or plain text according to Sanic negotiation.

Error413.description: Request exceeds configured size limit. Raised framework errors may use JSON, HTML or plain text according to Sanic negotiation.

Error415.description: Unsupported media type. Raised framework errors may use JSON, HTML or plain text according to Sanic negotiation.

Error429.description: Rate limit exceeded. Raised framework errors may use JSON, HTML or plain text according to Sanic negotiation.

Error503.description: Required dependency unavailable. Raised framework errors may use JSON, HTML or plain text according to Sanic negotiation.

UnexpectedError.description: Unexpected framework, dependency, or adapter error. The implementation does not use a uniform RFC 9457 error envelope.

inputs.description: Typed values defined by the exact profile version; omitted inputs defaults to an empty object.

FlowSubmission.description: Exactly one inline DAG or exact delivery_profile name@version. IDs omitted by callers are generated. Paid retries require an explicit stable id. Runtime additionally enforces deployment capabilities, profiles, policies, graph and document dependencies.

PreparedNode.description: Serialized workflow node. Contains capability-specific fields described by Workflow_node_* plus server-resolved id and parent. Serialization may add defaults and null fields not accepted by the input schemas; use the corresponding input capability contract when constructing submissions.

ArchiveManifest.description: Complete immutable snapshot. Each unique field names an uploaded file. created requires a timezone and is mandatory when Idempotency-Key is supplied. expires must be later than created. Multiple representations require a default_representation_id belonging to the version. Identity fields omitted by clients are derived from the idempotency key.

Workflow_temporary_document.description: An immutable temporary document. Omitted source defaults to temporary.

Workflow_archived_document.description: An immutable document, optionally pinned to one archive version.

Workflow_rendered_document.description: A document rendered from typed payload data during workflow execution.

Workflow_bundled_document.description: A ZIP document built from other document IDs.

Workflow_node_archive.description: Store complete immutable version snapshots in a configured archive.

Workflow_node_bundle.description: Create one ZIP archive from one to 25 document sources.

Workflow_node_debug.description: Record a development diagnostic outcome without external delivery.

Workflow_node_doccle.description: Publish one document to a Doccle receiver selected by ID or subject.

Workflow_node_email.description: Send an email body and optional generated-document attachments.

Workflow_node_generate.description: Materialize zero or more referenced, rendered, archived, or bundled documents.

Workflow_node_peppol.description: Submit one existing UBL document through the server-configured Peppol provider.

Workflow_node_postal.description: Produce and hand over a physical Belgian letter using a configured postal destination.
x-runtime-constraints: extensions must encode to at most 16384 bytes
production availability and carrier products depend on the configured destination

Workflow_node_search-index.description: Index exactly one immutable document source in a named search destination.

Workflow_node_sftp.description: Upload one document source to a relative path at a configured SFTP destination.
x-runtime-constraints: path is normalized and must not contain traversal or NUL characters

Workflow_node_signature.description: Sign referenced PDFs and write the results to temporary storage.
x-runtime-constraints: policy must exist in the deployment's signing policy registry

Workflow_node_transform.description: Convert, merge, or split existing document representations.
x-runtime-constraints: split page ranges require start <= end
merge and split accept PDF inputs only
transform input and output bytes are bounded by deployment configuration

Workflow_node_ubl.description: Add embedded attachments to a UBL Invoice or CreditNote and publish a new temporary document.
x-runtime-constraints: input and output must validate against the deployment's UBL 2.1 XSDs
signed XML, duplicate attachment IDs, and temporary input/output collisions are rejected
filename must be a basename; attachment MIME types and cumulative sizes are bounded
UBL schema validation does not replace Peppol business-profile validation

Workflow_node_wait-for.description: Wait with configured backoffs for immutable archive documents to become available.

Workflow_node_webhook.description: Send data or source-backed multipart fields to a public HTTP(S) endpoint.
x-runtime-constraints: the endpoint must resolve only to globally routable addresses
redirects and URL credentials are rejected
